_: The app's keyboard shortcuts, read by lib/shortcuts.ts: the Keyboard shortcuts sheet and Settings › Shortcuts draw this table, and lib/keys.ts maps presses to its ids (add a line there for a new one). group is the heading an item is under; count makes items 1..count, with {n} in label; sep puts a gap before the item; what is how a list names it when that differs from label. Keys are written for a Mac (⌘K) and shown as Ctrl+K elsewhere (lib/platform.ts); a Shift shortcut needs a line above the Shift guard in lib/keys.ts.
